items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: Well first on trombone, if besides myself, Wendell Eugene, Homer Eugene, Leonard Morris on trumpet, Warren Binary on trumpet, Gilbert Young on trumpet...

ctx.x: Well first on trombone, if besides myself, Wendell Eugene, Homer Eugene, Leonard Morris on trumpet, Warren Binary on trumpet, Gilbert Young on trumpet, Warren Binary on trumpet, Warren Bell on drums, Walter Epps guitar.
Warren Dahl on drums? Which one is this?
